nodes.title: 2 - Generate
widgets_values: The image is a macro photograph of a green tree frog sitting on a broad banana leaf covered in water droplets. The frog has smooth lime-green skin, bright red eyes with vertical black pupils, and orange toes with round sticky pads gripping the leaf. Its blue and yellow flank stripes are partly visible. Droplets on the leaf act like small lenses, reflecting the jungle behind. The background is a deep blurred green with soft circular highlights. Light comes from above and slightly behind, giving a glossy rim highlight on the frog's back. The image is razor sharp on the eyes, with a very shallow depth of field.

nodes.title: Usage
widgets_values: MiniMax-H3-Image expects a detailed English description of the whole image (subject, layout, light, style, any text to render). Short prompts give plain images. Zero dimensions use 2048 x 2048; sides must be multiples of 32 and the model is trained for 4 to 20 MP (4096 x 4096 gives the most detail). Steps stay at 6. Connect up to 16 IMAGE references and name them <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, ... in the prompt. Install the Diffusers revision from the node README into the model environment and select its python_executable in the loader. profile int8-attention is faster at 16 MP and changes the image slightly; model-offload fits smaller cards. The MiniMax-H3-Image Community License excludes the EU, the UK, the Republic of Korea and the USA. See the node README.
